meta.title: UK Awareness Days, Weeks & Months
meta.scope: Awareness days, weeks and months observed in the UK, including widely marked UN and international days.
meta.note: Running history: rows are kept after they pass. status 'confirmed' means the organiser has published the date, or it follows a fixed date or calendar rule; 'provisional' means estimated from the organiser's usual pattern and should be checked against source_url before it is relied on. source_url is the organiser's page; null for calendar dates with no single organiser.
